ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question-2
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: China's once famous "Three Great Wastelands" have now become the "Three Great Storehouses": the "Great Northern Wilderness" has become a grain storehouse, the "Great Western Wilderness" has become a cotton storehouse, and the "Great Southern Wilderness" has become a storehouse of rubber forests and tropical cash crops. The figure below is a schematic diagram of the distribution of China's "Three Great Wastelands." Read the figure and answer: <image1> What are the favorable climatic conditions in terms of sunlight conditions for the development of cotton production in the "Great Western Wilderness"?
